## Programme price for 2027

All prices are in USD per person. The price includes 4-star hotels with breakfast and services as described in the programme.

| Group size | Double occupancy (DBL) | Single occupancy (SGL) |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 10 people | $3,672 | $5,359 |
| 20 people | $3,486 | $5,172 |

## Hotels and room categories

Accommodation in the hotels listed or hotels of a similar category.

| Destination | Hotel | Room category | Nights |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Rio de Janeiro | Arena Leme | Superior Room | 2 |
| Foz do Iguaçu | Vivaz Cataratas | Standard Room | 2 |
| Lima | Casa Andina Premium Miraflores | Standard Room | 2 |
| Sacred Valley | Sol Ollantay Exclusive Hotel | Superior | 1 |
| Aguas Calientes | Casa del Sol Machu Picchu | Standard | 1 |
| Cusco | Casa Andina Premium San Blas | Superior Room | 1 |
| Buenos Aires | 474 Buenos Aires | Standard Room | 3 |
| El Calafate | Xelena Hotel | Standard | 2 |

Breakfast is included. Day 1 includes dinner in Rio without drinks, and Day 8 includes lunch in the Sacred Valley. International and domestic flights are paid for separately.

## Optional excursions

| Service | Price per person |
| --- | ---: |
| Great Adventure at Iguazu | $125 |
| Bird Park, Parque das Aves | $60 |
| Perito Moreno ice trekking | $300 |
